name: Event
summary: Records that something happened which the business reacts to, and forbids changing it afterwards, so that the log of what happened stays trustworthy and a correction has to be a new fact.

roles.name: Event
roles.summary: The thing that happened. Its source data is immutable: once created it is never edited, because editing it would break the integrity of the log it belongs to. A record later found to be wrong is corrected by a further event and an adjustment, never in place.

roles.name: EventType
roles.summary: What kind of event this is, as an object, so that which kinds exist is configured and a rule can be attached to a kind rather than to a class.

roles.name: WhenOccurred
roles.summary: When the thing happened in the world, as against when the system learned of it. An event carries both, so a figure can be restated later without the restatement pretending it was known at the time.

roles.name: WhenNoticed
roles.summary: When the system learned of it. It differs from when the event occurred, and holding the two apart is what lets a correction be dated honestly instead of overwriting history.
